title: Gradescope assignment outline
description: Request body for Gradescope's outline save endpoint (PATCH /courses/{cid}/assignments/{aid}/outline/). Used by the Gradescope Outline JSON Import/Export userscript. Importing REPLACES the whole saved outline, so include every question you want to keep.

identification_regions.description: Where students write their identity on the template.

name.description: Name region, or null for none.

sid.description: Student ID region, or null for none.

question_data.description: Top-level questions, in outline order. Numbering (1, 1.1, 1.2, ...) is assigned by position.

rect.description: A rectangle on one template page. All coordinates are PERCENT (0-100) of that page's width (x) or height (y), measured from the top-left corner.

x2.description: Right edge, % of page width. Must be greater than x1.

y2.description: Bottom edge, % of page height. Must be greater than y1.

title.description: Name shown in the outline and when grading.

weight.description: Points. For a question with children this should equal the sum of the children's weights.

crop_rect_list.description: Where students answer. Required for questions without children. Optional for questions with children: the importer copies the first child's rectangle.

children.description: Subquestions. Gradescope allows only one level of subquestions, so children must not have children.
